messages:
mia (People Ops): Quick thread — planning distribution of "thank-you" pouches for the next two weeks. We want to: 1) send to new hires joining on 6/3 & 6/10, 2) include a small spot-award card for winners next Friday, and 3) have a volunteer to handle packing at SF office. Who can help?
jamie (Events): I can run packing on the 5th. Need counts & a packing checklist. :+1:
mia (People Ops): Awesome, thx. Current counts: SF office 28, NY 12, Remote kits 45. Spot-award cards ~6 (we'll hand those to managers to insert). Checklist draft below.
ops-bot: New checklist created: https://faux.docs/redwood/thank-you-pouch-checklist (view-only)
taylor (Facilities): I can reserve a table in the SF lounge for the 5th from 10am-2pm and get extra tape/scissors. Do you need boxes for shipping?
jamie (Events): Yes, please. We'll need 3 small boxes for NY and a pallet for SF handouts? Maybe better to ship NY kits separately via PonyShip.
morgan (Finance): Reminder: budget code 4-RECOG-2026 for swag & postage. If cost per pouch > $12, please ping me before ordering.
mia (People Ops): Packing checklist (short):
- Verify recipient list (CSV)
- Print personalized insert card for spot award recipients only
- Pack: sticker, enamel pin, snack, handwritten note (template in sheet)
- Seal bag + add packing slip for shipped kits
- Dropoff labels preprinted for NY shipments
- Scan a photo of each packed kit and drop into the "pouch-photos" folder

jamie (Events): I'll bring the label printer and volunteer sign-up sheet. Volunteers so far: jamie, alex (Events), priya (Ops). Need two more for midday shift.
taylor (Facilities): I'll order tape + 2x scissors and set up the table. Also can coordinate courier for NY drop-off at 3pm on the 5th.
mia (People Ops): Logistics note: Remote kits — ops team will ship from the SF office using our prepaid labels on 6/6. Please ensure addresses are validated by EOD 6/4.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Validate addresses by 2024-06-04T17:00:00Z
jamie (Events): Can someone confirm if managers will write a 1-line personal note for the spot-award cards or do we print a template?
mia (People Ops): Managers will handwrite a short note — we'll print blank cards and include a pens station during packing.
morgan (Finance): Also confirm if custom pins exceeded MOQ — procurement already cleared. Total spend estimate under code 4-RECOG-2026 is $680.
jamie (Events): Volunteer rota: 10:00-12:00 (jamie, alex, priya), 12:00-14:00 (tbd, tbd). Anyone for afternoon?
priya (Ops): I can do 12:00-14:00.
taylor (Facilities): Courier booked for NY at 15:00 on 5th. SF pickup will be ready by 14:30.
mia (People Ops): Final asks: (1) volunteers to fill the two open spots, (2) someone to QA the recipient CSV (simple duplicate check), (3) confirm pens + markers availability.
jamie (Events): I'll QA the CSV tonight and upload cleaned file to the folder.
priya (Ops): Pens + markers are in the supply closet — I'll bring them.
mia (People Ops): Perfect — thank you. Will post final checklist & shipping labels once Jamie uploads the CSV. :sparkles:
jamie (Events): Uploaded CSV and packing labels here: https://faux.docs/redwood/thank-you-pouch-6-5-assets
ops-bot: Event reminder scheduled: Packing table set on 2024-06-05 10:00 PT
taylor (Facilities): Table reserved, supplies ordered.
jamie (Events): Two volunteer spots filled (sam and lina). We're golden.
mia (People Ops): Closing loop — will update the recognition team after shipping. High level timeline: 6/4 address validation complete -> 6/5 packing -> 6/6 remote ship -> 6/10 2nd new hire batch. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
